<script>
function escapeSingleQuote(str) {
    return str.replace(/'/g, "''");
}

$(document).ready(function() {
    // Retrieve values and escape single quotes
    const uuid = escapeSingleQuote(document.getElementById('id').value);

    // Construct the URL with encoded parameters
    const iframeSrc = `/jw/web/userview/appcenter/home/_/liste_des_diplomes?embed=true&id_master=${encodeURIComponent(uuid)}`;

    // Set the src attribute of the iframe
    document.getElementById('iframe_objectif').src = iframeSrc;
});

</script>
